purpose: Expose evidence holes using only the least restrictive copyright classes before considering attribution, share-alike, copyleft, noncommercial, mixed, or ambiguous sources.
required_before_mining: exact artifact, release, branch, or dated export is identified
the license applies to the content fields used, not merely packaging or software
component filters are machine-enforced where only a subset is eligible
source, language, variety, date, register, and upstream provenance are retained
privacy, publicity, trademark, community, sacred-text, and endorsement constraints are reviewed separately
an accepted mining execution decision is recorded separately from this policy

eligible_units.scope: Structured data in the Lexeme namespace and referenced structured entities only; exclude prose/documentation namespaces.
eligible_units.caution: CC0 permits reuse but does not make community statements correct, complete, or accepted canon.

eligible_units.scope: UN Parallel Corpus v1.0 official records and supplied alignments only.
obligations: acknowledge the United Nations as source
retain the corpus disclaimer and citation
eligible_units.caution: Public-domain status does not make diplomatic and parliamentary language representative of general usage.

eligible_units.scope: The separately identified Sentences (CC0) export only; exclude the general sentences, links, audio, transcriptions, tags, lists, and pair exports unless separately proven eligible.
eligible_units.caution: The CC0 sentence file alone does not establish which sentence pairs are translations; translation equivalence remains a hole under this tier.

eligible_units.scope: The exact pinned plain-text body of Ebook 22 as a dated electronic edition; retain the original file and Project Gutenberg license separately, and do not label the extracted content a faithful 1911 transcription.
obligations: preserve the artifact header and provenance
comply with Project Gutenberg trademark terms if its name remains associated
eligible_units.caution: The electronic edition contains later additions, rearrangements, markup, and transcription errors. Mine source structure as evidence from this electronic edition, not as recovered original Roget canon.

eligible_units.scope: Published translation files whose publication metadata identifies CC0 and SuttaCentral support; exclude root, variant, comment, HTML, reference, and other layers until separately verified.
eligible_units.caution: A CC0 translation without an independently eligible source-text layer cannot by itself supply a licensed Pali-English alignment. Preserve religious and historical register.
